scope: Inspector-only LLM annotation. It is not stored in, learned by, hashed by, or supplied to Reflector-II.
author: Codex (LLM), from the displayed predicate signatures and audited runtime emitters

Kind.label: has sensory entity kind
Kind.rationale: Associates an entity with an emitted carrier-level kind such as Cell, Region, or Figure.

Connected.label: is four-neighbor connected
Connected.rationale: Marks a region produced as one same-valued four-neighbor connected component.

Color.label: has palette value
Color.rationale: Associates a perceived entity with its nominal grid or palette value.

Form.label: has normalized occupancy form
Form.rationale: Associates a region with its translation-normalized occupied-cell fingerprint.

Enclosed.label: is an enclosed background region
Enclosed.rationale: Marks a background component that does not connect to the frame boundary.

Inside.label: lies inside an owning region
Inside.rationale: Relates an enclosed background component to the foreground region that contains it.

EnclosureCount.label: has enclosed-region count
EnclosureCount.rationale: Records how many enclosed background components are owned by a perceived region.

Count.label: has element count
Count.rationale: Records the audited cardinality of a perceived component.

Value.label: has scalar cell value
Value.rationale: Associates a cell entity with its nominal observed grid value.

At.label: is at local coordinates
At.rationale: Places a cell at coordinates relative to its containing region's bounding box.

PartOf.label: is part of a region
PartOf.rationale: Relates an emitted cell entity to its containing connected region.

OutlineForm.label: has outer-outline form
OutlineForm.rationale: Associates a figure with the normalized fingerprint of its hole-filled outer occupancy.

InteriorContrastCount.label: has interior-contrast count
InteriorContrastCount.rationale: Counts distinct interior contrast regions grouped beneath the same outer outline.

Contains.label: contains a component region
Contains.rationale: Relates a grouped figure to one of the perceived regions it contains.

SameOutline.label: has the same outer outline as
SameOutline.rationale: Relates two figures whose outer-outline fingerprints are equal.

SameInteriorContrast.label: has matching interior contrast
SameInteriorContrast.rationale: Relates same-outline figures with equal interior-contrast counts.

DifferentInteriorContrast.label: has different interior contrast
DifferentInteriorContrast.rationale: Relates same-outline figures whose interior-contrast counts differ.

Domain.label: is the source state of a mapping
Domain.rationale: Marks the source-side state variable of a learned relational mapping.

Codomain.label: is the destination state of a mapping
Codomain.rationale: Marks the destination-side state variable of a learned relational mapping.

Intervention.label: uses intervention token
Intervention.rationale: Records the opaque action token associated with a transition.

Before.label: holds before the transition
Before.rationale: Records a relation value on the source side of a learned transition.

After.label: holds after the transition
After.rationale: Records a relation value on the destination side of a learned transition.

Preserve.label: is preserved by the transition
Preserve.rationale: Marks a relation whose selected value remains unchanged across a transition.

Change.label: changes across the transition
Change.rationale: Marks a relation whose selected value differs across a transition.

Less.label: is quantitatively less than
Less.rationale: Records an audited increasing relation between ordered quantitative values.
